label: C1 原稿
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: One high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, exactly 1600 x 1000 landscape, full viewport straight-on screenshot with no browser chrome, no device frame.
Primary request: Design the Chinese internal trade order management application 贸易协同 as a polished modern translation of Metro typographic tiles. This is a functional enterprise order workspace for a business supervisor, not a marketing page or poster.
Structure: A charcoal full-width horizontal top navigation with brand at left, five navigation items, search and account at right. No expanded left sidebar. Below is a restrained 32px title 订单工作区. The next area occupies about 25% of the viewport and contains three purposefully unequal rectangular flat color panels on one strong grid: a large cyan selected-order identity panel, a medium magenta document-review task panel with a small flat white document preview silhouette, and a narrower lime payment summary panel. Their prominent labels must be independently 订单进度, 单证进度, 收款进度. These are parallel dimensions of a single order, never steps in one sequence. Below, a large quiet dark table occupies roughly the lower 55% of the screen, including filters, crisp readable column headers, three well-spaced actual data rows and pagination. Do not add extra rows or invented data. Maintain credible business UI density, precise alignment, ample compact whitespace, sharp controls and square or 2px corners.
Style: Charcoal #171C20 background, cyan #00A8B5 order field, magenta #B63E85 document field, lime #C9E766 smaller payment field. Crisp white typography on dark and magenta; dark ink on lime and cyan where necessary for readable contrast. Color owns complete purposeful regions, with a sophisticated flat grid and exact CJK sans typography. Table is charcoal with fine neutral horizontal rules; selected row has a subtle lighter dark background. All amounts right-aligned with their currency. State tags use clear text and independent semantic colors, not the decorative panel color. No shadows, gradients, glowing edges, glass, neon sci-fi, overly rounded cards, decorative graphs or generic metric dashboard.
Top navigation text verbatim: 贸易协同 | 工作台 | 订单查询 | 单证管理 | 审核与异常 | 统计分析. Selected 订单查询 must be clearly cyan text with a slim cyan underline. Search input placeholder 搜索工作区, shortcut ⌘K. Right account: square avatar ZJG, username zhoujg, read-only role 业务主管, separate 退出登录. The role must not be a dropdown or switcher.
Page heading: 订单工作区. Small honest label 原型样例 next to it, never an eyebrow above it.
Cyan panel: label 订单进度, order SO2026001, amount 24,100.00 USD, state 执行中, restrained action 查看订单.
Magenta panel: label 单证进度, state 待审核 in an amber textual status tag, small clean white document silhouette with title Commercial Invoice and restrained linework, one obvious button 审核单证. No fabricate names or detailed invoice entries.
Lime panel: label 收款进度, state 部分收款, amount 12,000.00 USD, small label 已收. This is a read-only summary without payment-entry button or arrow to the document panel.
Table heading: 订单列表. Filter toolbar: input 搜索订单, dropdown 全部订单进度, dropdown 全部单证进度, dropdown 全部收款进度, aligned right 查询 and 重置. Table columns exactly 订单 | 金额 | 订单进度 | 单证进度 | 收款进度 | 操作. Row 1: SO2026001 | 24,100.00 USD | 执行中 | 待审核 | 部分收款 | 查看. Row 2: SO2026003 | 19,500.00 EUR | 待执行 | 未开始 | 未收款 | 查看. Row 3: SO2026005 | 28,150.00 USD | 执行中 | 制作中 | 未收款 | 查看. Footer 共 3 条 with quiet pagination 1.
Constraints: All Chinese must be clean, sharp, legible Simplified Chinese with every required label spelled correctly. Preserve the exact order IDs, amounts, currencies and independent statuses. Do not sum USD with EUR. No create-order button, no 新建订单, no direct role selector, no sequential workflow arrows, no extra financial claims. This is only a visual concept of a prototype. High craft, full-fidelity product design screenshot, not a palette board.
